_about: House voices for every channel, designed once with Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign (Oct 27, 2026). Keys keep the old Kokoro names so existing scripts work unchanged. Each voice is saved as <key>.wav + its transcript below; Qwen3-TTS Base clones from that clip every night. Original voices, not copies of any real person.
ref_text: Okay, so here is the thing nobody tells you. You can plan every little detail, and life will still find a way to surprise you. Honestly? That is half the fun.

af_bella.used_for: June, Keegix Podcast host; Snortlo narrator option
af_bella.instruct: A bright, warm, confident American woman in her late twenties. Friendly podcast host energy, clear and expressive, natural conversational rhythm, smiling while she talks.

am_michael.used_for: Sam, Staffkin Podcast host; Snortlo narrator option
am_michael.instruct: A calm, grounded American man in his mid thirties with a warm baritone. Thoughtful radio host, relaxed pace, kind and reassuring, never stiff.

am_puck.instruct: A playful, energetic young American man in his early twenties. Comedic timing, quick and expressive, slightly mischievous, sounds like he is telling a funny story to friends.

af_heart.instruct: A soft, warm young American woman with a gentle storyteller voice. Cozy, unhurried and soothing, like reading a bedtime story to a friend.

bm_george.instruct: A mature British man in his fifties, warm and wry, slightly gravelly, a seasoned bed and breakfast owner who has seen it all.

bf_emma.instruct: A confident British woman in her forties, practical, kind and direct, an experienced operations manager.

am_adam.instruct: A relaxed, friendly American man in his forties, easygoing small business owner with a down to earth voice.

af_nicole.instruct: A soft spoken, thoughtful American woman in her thirties, measured and calm, like a counsellor.

bm_lewis.instruct: An articulate young British man in his late twenties, curious and upbeat, clear diction.

af_sarah.instruct: A lively, outgoing American woman in her thirties, fast talker with a big laugh in her voice.

am_eric.instruct: A deep voiced, steady American man in his fifties, slow and authoritative but friendly.

bf_isabella.instruct: A bright young British woman in her twenties, quick witted and cheerful.

af_kore.instruct: An energetic young Canadian woman in her twenties, upbeat and friendly, casual and modern.

bm_daniel.instruct: An older British man in his sixties, gentle and wise, soft spoken with a slight rasp.
